- '3.11'

about.description:
Python module for computing edit distances and alignments between sequences.
I needed a way to compute edit distances between sequences in Python. I
wasn't able to find any appropriate libraries that do this so I wrote my
own. There appear to be numerous edit distance libraries available for
computing edit distances between two strings, but not between two sequences.
This is written entirely in Python. This implementation could likely be
optimized to be faster within Python. And could probably be much faster if
implemented in C.
The library API is modeled after difflib.SequenceMatcher. This is very
similar to difflib, except that this module computes edit distance
(Levenshtein distance) rather than the Ratcliff and Oberhelp method
that Python's difflib uses.
about.summary: Computing edit distance on arbitrary Python sequences.

name: edit_distance
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "1.0.7"

package:
  name: edit_distance
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/e/edit_distance/edit_distance-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 607cea124391e92008816439b667b10fc3314ff4d4aecafe7b86171659773270

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv
  python:
    entry_points:
      - edit-distance = edit_distance.edit_distance:main

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - pip
    - poetry-core
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}

tests:
  - python:
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"
      imports:
        - edit_distance
      pip_check: true
  - files:
      recipe:
        - recipe.yaml
      # source:
      # - test
    requirements:
      run:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
        # - pytest
    script:
      - edit-distance recipe.yaml recipe.yaml
      # - pytest test

about:
  summary: Computing edit distance on arbitrary Python sequences.
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE
  description: |
    Python module for computing edit distances and alignments between sequences.
    I needed a way to compute edit distances between sequences in Python. I
    wasn't able to find any appropriate libraries that do this so I wrote my
    own. There appear to be numerous edit distance libraries available for
    computing edit distances between two strings, but not between two sequences.
    This is written entirely in Python. This implementation could likely be
    optimized to be faster within Python. And could probably be much faster if
    implemented in C.
    The library API is modeled after difflib.SequenceMatcher. This is very
    similar to difflib, except that this module computes edit distance
    (Levenshtein distance) rather than the Ratcliff and Oberhelp method
    that Python's difflib uses.
  homepage: https://github.com/belambert/editdistance
  repository: https://github.com/belambert/edit-distance
  documentation: http://edit-distance.readthedocs.io/en/latest/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - mr-c
    - CurtLH
